name: Investment Residence (Investor Quality)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum foreign-capital investment of US$200,000 (or equivalent in national currency), registered through CEI-RD (Centro de Exportación e Inversión de la República Dominicana). Other regimes (free zones, executive contracts, incentive laws) may carry different or no minimum.
requirements.fix_path: Register the qualifying investment with CEI-RD.

requirements.blocker_text: A Residence Visa (RS) must be obtained at a Dominican consulate before applying.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the RS visa at a Dominican consulate.

evidence_required.document: Company authorization letter with board certification and chamber of commerce endorsement

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Investment Residence (Investment Quality): US$200,000 minimum via CEI-RD, 1-year permit, 45 working days processing, fee breakdown

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). The source explicitly notes other investment regimes (free zones, executive contracts, incentive laws) may have different or no minimum -- not modeled as separate groups here given no tier-1 breakdown of those alternate thresholds was found; flagged as a gap. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months are the same chained inference used across this country's routes (see do_permanent_residence.json and do_naturalisation.json) -- not a figure stated for this specific route.
